blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views. We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state. We show that these fixed views substantially help the model to maintain consistency. We also show that, due to their redundant and semi-static nature, the auxiliary views can be efficiently compressed with a delta-VAE that encodes only the changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens required to process them. Experiments in Minecraft and Doom demonstrate improved world and agent consistency, with qualitative results on real-world multi-camera captures indicating that the approach is not tied to game engines. Our compression analysis further shows that delta-VAE substantially reduces the computational overhead of auxiliary-view generation. We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.
blocks.zh: 尽管视频世界模式取得了成功,但是将其推广到多个代理是困难的,因为它需要生成数个在时间和代理之间一致的针对代理的视频流. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了OverSeerr,一种多代理世界模型,通过辅助摄像头视图来增强以自我为中心的代理视图. 我们建议,通过确定空间中的辅助观点,它们充当以世界为中心的代表: 与代理人观点不同的是,由于代理人位置的简单改变,代理人观点可以完全改变,辅助观点的改变直接映射到世界状态的局部变化. 我们表明,这些固定观点大大有助于模式保持一致性。 我们还表明,由于其冗余和半静态的性质,辅助视图可以通过只编码相对于静态参考图像的变化的三角洲-VAE来有效压缩,从而减少处理它们所需的令牌数量. Minecraft 和 Doom 的实验展示了世界和剂一致性的改善,关于现实世界多相机捕捉的定性结果表明,这个方法没有与游戏引擎挂钩. 我们的压缩分析进一步显示,Derta-VAE大大降低了辅助视图生成的计算间接费用. 我们的结论是,这些固定的观点为改进多代理世界模式提供了简单有效的途径。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World models aim to learn predictive representations of environments.
Video world models represent the environment as a sequence of images captured from the viewpoint of an acting agent, predicting future frames conditioned on past observations and agent actions.
By taking advantage of large video datasets, these models can learn to represent complex visual dynamics and interactions between characters and objects.
Recent video world models have made substantial progress in visual fidelity and character controllability, but maintaining a coherent world over long horizons remains challenging.
Small prediction errors can accumulate over time, causing objects to drift and environments to change inconsistently.
blocks.zh:
世界模型旨在学习预测性的环境表现。
视频世界模型代表环境,是从一个代理商的角度捕捉到的图像的序列,预测以过去的观察和代理行为为条件的未来帧.
通过利用大型视频数据集,这些模型可以学习代表复杂的视觉动态和人物与物体之间的相互作用.
近期的影视世界模型在视觉忠诚和人物可控性方面取得了实质性进展,但维持一个连贯的世界在漫长的视野中仍然具有挑战性.
小的预测误差可以随着时间的推移累积,导致物体漂移,环境变化不一致.

blocks.en:
These challenges become more pronounced in multi-agent environments.
A multi-agent world model must represent not only how the environment evolves but also how multiple characters interact within the same shared world.
We identify two forms of consistency that are essential for this setting.
First, world consistency requires persistent scene elements and the effects of past events to be preserved over time: when an agent revisits a location, the scene should reflect its history.
Second, agent consistency requires the actions and states of different agents to agree across their observations: an interaction should be depicted consistently in all views from which it is visible.
These constraints are difficult to satisfy using only player-centric streams, because each player observes only a partial and changing projection of the underlying world .
blocks.zh:
这些挑战在多种代理环境中变得更加明显。
多代理世界模式不仅必须代表环境如何演变,而且必须代表多个人物在同一个共享世界中如何互动。
我们确定了两种形式的一致性,对于这一背景至关重要。
首先,世界一致性要求持续存在的场景元素和过去事件的影响要随着时间的推移加以保存:当特工重访某个地点时,场景应当反映其历史.
第二,代理人的一致性要求不同代理人的行动和状态在他们的意见中达成一致:所有观点中都应一致地描述一种互动,而这种互动是显而易见的。
这些限制很难仅使用玩家为中心的流来满足,因为每个玩家只观察到对基础世界的部分和变化的投影. .

blocks.en:
One way to address these challenges is to use a world-centric representation that explicitly maintains a shared state independent of any individual agent’s viewpoint.
Such representations can also model dynamics more efficiently: localized updates occur only when the environment actually changes, whereas an agent’s camera motion drastically alters egocentric pixels even in a completely static scene.
However, explicitly reconstructing and maintaining a world-centric representation from partial observations remains challenging.
blocks.zh:
应对这些挑战的一个方法是使用以世界为中心的代表,明确保持一个独立于任何个别代理人观点的共同国家。
这样的表达还可以更高效地模拟动态:只有当环境发生实际变化时才会出现局部更新,而代理人的相机运动即使在一个完全静态的场景中也会急剧改变自我中心像素.
然而,从部分观察中明确重建和保持以世界为中心的代表性仍然是挑战。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a video-based framework that captures the key advantages of a world-centric representation without requiring explicit global state reconstruction.
To this end, we introduce OverSeer , a multi-agent video world model augmented with fixed-pose auxiliary camera views that serve as a practical proxy for a shared world-centric state.
At inference, the auxiliary views are automatically, jointly, and efficiently generated with the agents’ views through shared attention.
This design has three benefits: (i) Auxiliary views cover regions beyond individual agents’ immediate fields of view, establishing a shared visual reference that grounds cross-agent interactions; (ii) Because the auxiliary cameras are stationary, any temporal variation in their views reflects actual environmental changes rather than camera ego-motion; (iii) Fixed viewpoints make temporal redundancies predictable and easy to model, reinforcing structural coherence across streams .
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了一个以视频为基础的框架,抓住以世界为中心的代表制的主要优势,而不需要明确的全球国家重建。
为此,我们引入了Oversear, 一种多代理视频世界模型, 并增加了固定的相机辅助视图,
推论,辅助观点通过共同关注而自动、联合和有效地与代理人的观点产生。
这种设计有三个好处:(一) 辅助观点涵盖单个代理的直接视野以外的区域,建立共同的视觉参照,为跨代理相互作用提供依据;(二) 由于辅助摄像机是固定的,因此其观点中的任何时间变化都反映了实际的环境变化,而不是照相机自觉运动;(三) 固定观点使时间冗余具有可预测性和易于建模,加强各流的结构一致性。

blocks.en:
To minimize computational overhead and exploit this inherent temporal redundancy, we introduce δ \delta -VAE, a variational autoencoder that performs second-stage latent compression on top of a standard video VAE.
For each auxiliary stream, δ \delta -VAE retains an initial reference frame latent and encodes subsequent frames into compact residual latents conditioned on that reference.
The static reference frame preserves persistent background geometry, enabling the residual latents to concentrate exclusively on dynamic events, such as agent movements, object manipulations, and environmental state changes.
By eliminating redundant encoding of unchanged background content, six auxiliary views incur only 37.5% of the token overhead of the two agent streams.

通过取消无变化背景内容的冗余编码,6个辅助视图只承担了两个代理流的37.5%的代币间接费用.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion models have emerged as the dominant framework for video generation, evolving from early techniques that augmented pretrained 2D priors with temporal layers ( Singer et al., 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) to large-scale architectures scaled for high-fidelity synthesis ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) .
Video world models extend this paradigm by casting environment simulation as action-conditioned video diffusion, where future frame generation is guided by past observations and agent actions to yield interactive simulators ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ) .
Recent full-stack systems further enrich this formulation by integrating explicit camera control, scene memory, and real-time streaming ( DreamX et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
传播模型已成为视频生成的主要框架,从早期技术(Singer等人,2023年;Blattmann等人,2023年)增加时间层预先训练的2D前科发展为大规模结构,用于高真实性合成(OpenAI,2024年;Google DeepMind,2025年;HaCohen等人,2025年;Wan等人,2025年)。
视频世界模型通过铸造环境模拟作为动作条件视频传播来扩展这一范式,未来帧生成在以往观测和代理动作的指导下产生交互式模拟器(Bruce等人,2024年;Valevski等人,2025年).
最近的全层系统通过整合显式相机控制,场景内存,以及实时流线,进一步丰富了这种配方(DreamX等,2026年;Jiang等,2026年;Wang等,2026年).

blocks.en:
However, progress in this domain mainly focuses on expanding the input conditioning space, while output generation remains restricted to rendering a single egocentric stream for a single agent.
In contrast, OverSeer shifts focus to the model’s output space: given initial frames and actions from all agents, the model jointly predicts every agent’s egocentric stream alongside the fixed auxiliary camera views, improving both world and agent consistency .
blocks.zh:
然而,这个领域的进展主要侧重于扩展输入调制空间,而输出生成仍然局限于为单一代理制造单一的自我中心流.
对比之下,OverSeerr将焦点转移到模型的输出空间:鉴于所有代理商的初始框架和行动,该模型与固定的辅助相机视图一起共同预测每个代理商的自我中心流,改善世界和代理商的一致性。

blocks.en:
Autoregressive rollouts in video world models tend to compound error and spatial drift over extended horizons ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
The prevailing remedy is expanding context capacity through positional extrapolation or streaming attention ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) , memory-bank retrieval by estimated camera pose ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , and geometry-guided retrieval ( DreamX et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
However, these memory structures are constructed entirely from an agent’s own past observations. Consequently, unobserved regions are never stored, and retrieval accuracy remains bound to pose estimates that drift alongside generation.
Our pose-fixed auxiliary views serve a complementary function: while memory recalls previously observed regions, auxiliary streams provide active coverage of unobserved space.
Furthermore, because these auxiliary views are jointly predicted rather than retrieved, they eliminate reliance on fragile pose estimation altogether.
blocks.zh:
在视频世界模型中自动推出,往往会使误差和空间漂移在扩展的视野上复杂化(Chen等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年)。
主要的补救措施是通过位置推断或流注来扩大上下文能力(Yang等人,2026年;Yesiltepe等人,2026年),按估计相机姿势进行记忆库检索(Yu等人,2025年a;Hong等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026年),以及几何学指导检索(DreamX等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年)。
然而,这些内存结构完全是根据代理人自己过去的观察构建的。 因此,从未对未观测区域进行储存,检索的准确性仍然必然会产生漂移与生成的估计数。
我们的姿势固定的辅助观点起到补充作用:虽然记忆可以回顾以前观察到的区域,但辅助流可以积极覆盖未观测空间。
此外,由于这些辅助观点是共同预测的,而不是检索的,因此完全消除了对脆弱因素估计的依赖。

blocks.en:
Multi-agent world models were first studied in reinforcement learning with compact state spaces ( Egorov and Shpilman, 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , where multi-view consistency is enforced within an unrendered latent state.
Recent work extends this requirement to the pixel domain, conditioning video diffusion models on multiple action streams to synthesize concurrent agent views ( Enigma, 2025 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ) . Multi-view generation also appears in generative 3D modeling and autonomous driving ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Jang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2024a ; Gao et al., 2024b ; Gao et al., 2024c ) , though cameras in these settings are typically in a static scene or camera rigs rigidly attached to a single moving platform.
blocks.zh:
多代理世界模型首先在用紧凑的状态空间进行强化学习时被研究(Egorov and Shpilman, 2022; Zhang等人, 2025),其中多观点一致性在一个不屈不挠的潜伏状态下强制实施.
最近的工作将这一要求扩大到像素域,在多个动作流上配置视频传播模型,以合成并行的代理视图(Enigma,2025年;Savva等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年a;Hu等人,2026年a); Wu等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年b). 多景代也出现在基因3D模型和自主驱动中(Kong等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年b年;Jang等人,2026年;Gao等人,2024年a年;Gao等人,2024年b年b年;Gao等人,2024年c年c年c年c年),尽管这些环境下的摄像头一般是固定的场景或摄像机钻机固定在单个移动平台上.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches to multi-agent consistency broadly fall into two categories.
The first couples egocentric streams via stream concatenation, shared attention, tiling, or permutation-symmetric encodings ( Enigma, 2025 ; Savva et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , meaning every reference frame is itself a moving, partial observation.
The second improves consistency via an external state, such as an editable map with estimated per-agent poses ( Po et al., 2026 ) ; while this decouples the reference from individual agent trajectories, it models spatial geometry rather than visual appearance and remains vulnerable to pose drift.
blocks.zh:
现有多代理人一致性办法大致分为两类。
最早的夫妇以自我为中心的溪流通过溪流凝聚,共享关注,平板,或穿梭对称编码(Enigma, 2025; Savva等人, 2026; Hu等人, 2026a; Liu等人, 2026a), 意思是每个参考框架本身就是一个动人的,部分的观察.
第二种是通过外部状态提高一致性,例如可编辑的地图,其中包含估计的每剂外观(Po等人,2026年);虽然这与单个物剂轨迹的参考物脱钩,但它模拟了空间几何而非视觉外观,仍然容易形成漂移.

blocks.en: In contrast, OverSeer improves consistency by introducing auxiliary streams that are jointly predicted alongside the agents’ streams rather than supplied as external map inputs.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,OverSeer则通过引入与代理商的流一起共同预测的辅助流,而不是作为外部地图输入提供,提高了一致性.

blocks.en:
Modern video generators typically operate within the latent space of a video VAE ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2025 ) , with recent efficiency efforts compressing representations further via stronger tokenizers ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , token merging ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) , lightweight decoders, and bounded KV caches ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026a ) .
However, these generic techniques allocate computational capacity uniformly across all streams, causing an auxiliary camera view to incur nearly the same computational cost as an egocentric agent stream.
blocks.zh:
现代视频发电机一般在VAE视频(Wan等人,2025年;HaCohen等人,2025年)的潜在空间内运行,最近的效率努力通过更强的标注器进一步压缩表示(Yu等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年),符号合并(Bolya等人,2023年),轻量级解码器,以及捆绑的KV缓存(Jiang等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年a年)。
然而,这些通用技术在所有流流中统一分配计算能力,导致辅助相机视图的计算成本与以自我为中心的代理流几乎相同。

blocks.en:
A closer line of work changes what a latent space represents : neural video codecs encode frames relative to a reference frame via residuals ( Lu et al., 2019 ) or by conditioning ( Li et al., 2021 ) , RefTok tokenizes each frame relative to a reference frame ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , and DeltaTok compresses consecutive-frame feature differences into a single delta token ( Kerssies et al., 2026 ) .
In these approaches, the reference frame is not fixed, but updated regularly over time, missing the advantages of OverSeer’s fixed views, starting from the fact that they can be compressed effectively.
blocks.zh:
更紧密的工作线会改变潜在空间所代表的:神经视频编码器通过剩余物(Lu等人,2019年)或条件(Li等人,2021年)对参考物框架进行编码,RefTok将每个参考物框架与参考物框架进行编码(Fan等人,2025年),DeltaTok将连续框架特征差异压缩成单一三角形符号(Kersies等人,2026年)。
在这些方法中,参考框架不是固定的,而是随着时间而定期更新的,忽略了OverSeerr固定观点的优点,从这些观点可以有效压缩开始.

To provide persistent spatial references for the shared environment, OverSeer introduces K K fixed-pose auxiliary camera views, denoted by 𝐨 t X = { o t X , j } j = 1 K \mathbf{o}_{t}^{X}=\{o_{t}^{X,j}\}_{j=1}^{K} , with corresponding camera poses 𝐜 = { c j } j = 1 K \mathbf{c}=\{c^{j}\}_{j=1}^{K} , where the superscript X X denotes auxiliary camera streams.
Unlike agent-centric cameras, whose viewpoints change with agent motion, the auxiliary cameras remain fixed over time.
These views change proportionally to changes in the underlying world’s state and provide a stable spatial reference for all the agents.
During training, the auxiliary views also teach the model what happens outside the agents’ immediate purview.

We design OverSeer as a latent video diffusion model ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) built upon Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , leveraging its strong pre-trained video generation prior.
An overview is shown in fig. 2 .
Following the standard latent diffusion design, input visual observations are mapped into a compact latent space using a pre-trained video VAE ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , yielding agent latents 𝐳 t A = { ℰ ( o ) ; ∀ o ∈ 𝐨 t A } \mathbf{z}_{t}^{A}=\{\mathcal{E}(o);\forall o\in\mathbf{o}_{t}^{A}\} and auxiliary latents 𝐳 t X = { ℰ ( o ) ; ∀ o ∈ 𝐨 t X } \mathbf{z}_{t}^{X}=\{\mathcal{E}(o);\forall o\in\mathbf{o}_{t}^{X}\} .

Knowledge of the ground-truth auxiliary visual streams is only required during training. At inference, OverSeer receives the initial agent observations and agent actions along with auxiliary camera poses. The auxiliary camera poses are sampled from a scene-independent prior estimated from training poses and greedily selected to maximize field-of-view coverage without scene-specific input (see appendix B ).
The model jointly generates future agent observations and the auxiliary streams, including their initial anchor frames.
Ground-truth auxiliary images are used only during training.

We train OverSeer using diffusion forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , where diffusion timesteps are sampled independently across temporal positions, and target latents are noised accordingly while initial conditioning frames 𝐳 0 A \mathbf{z}_{0}^{A} remain clean.
All latents, including agent latents, auxiliary anchor frames, and residual codes, are projected to the same DiT hidden dimension with learnable view-identification embeddings added to each view’s tokens for differentiation.

blocks.en:
Agent and auxiliary streams are governed by different modalities and therefore use complementary conditioning pathways.
For each agent stream, discrete actions (including agent navigation, camera motions, and inventory interactions) are formatted into short textual descriptions, encoded via a frozen T5 text encoder ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) , and injected into the DiT layers through cross-attention.
For each auxiliary stream, camera pose c j c^{j} and its known intrinsics are converted into a spatial Plücker-ray map ( Sitzmann et al., 2021 ) .
These ray representations are patchified and projected into Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) ( Perez et al., 2018 ) , with scale and shift parameters to modulate the corresponding auxiliary tokens.

Tokens from all agents and auxiliary streams are then jointly processed by shared self-attention layers, enabling direct cross-modality communication.
We enforce a causal temporal attention mask throughout the network: tokens at a given temporal position t t can attend only to conditioning tokens and to tokens from identical or earlier temporal positions ( t ′ ≤ t t^{\prime}\leq t ).
This prevents future latent states from leaking into the prediction of earlier states under independent diffusion forcing timesteps.

blocks.en:
Because the auxiliary cameras are pose-fixed, their background visual content remains predominantly static across time, with scene updates concentrated in localized regions affected by agent activity and environmental dynamics. Directly modeling full latent representations for every auxiliary frame therefore introduces severe temporal and spatial redundancy.
To address this inefficiency, we introduce δ \delta -VAE, a second-stage variational autoencoder that exploits this background stationarity to further compress the latent streams produced by the primary video VAE.

为了解决这种效率低下的问题,我们引入了\\delta-VAE,一种第二阶段的变异自编码器,利用这种背景空间进一步压缩由主视频VAE产生的潜在流.

We train the δ \delta -VAE with three losses: an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reconstruction loss ℒ rec \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}} between the reconstructed and target video-VAE latents; the standard VAE KL divergence ℒ KL \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KL}} ; and a feature alignment loss ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{align}} inspired by REPA ( Yu et al., 2025b ) .
Reconstruction alone lets the residual code spend its capacity on static background that the anchor already provides; ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{align}} instead aligns the code with video-VAE features re-weighted toward dynamic regions.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We structure our experimental evaluation to test the central hypothesis of this work: extending a multi-agent video world model with pose-fixed, efficiently represented auxiliary views significantly improves both temporal and agent consistency compared to baselines ( section 4.1 ).
We then conduct ablation studies investigating how performance scales with the number of auxiliary views and how the δ \delta -VAE compression ratio influences synthesis quality and computational overhead ( section 4.2 ).
For qualitative results, please refer to our website and appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们组织我们的实验评价,以测试这项工作的中心假设:扩展一个多剂视频世界模型,其外形固定,高效地代表辅助观点,与基线相比,时间和剂的一致性都大大提高(第4.1节)。
然后,我们进行减速研究,调查性能尺度与辅助视图的数目以及X\delta-VAE压缩比如何影响合成质量和计算间接费用(第4.2节)。
关于质量结果,请参阅我们的网站和附录。

blocks.en: We evaluate world models by conditioning future frame rollouts on initial visual observations and multi-agent action trajectories. Primary quantitative evaluations are conducted in Minecraft , whose persistent and editable 3D world naturally tests spatial memory, multi-agent interaction, and cross-view consistency ( tables 1 and 2 ). To evaluate long-horizon spatial reasoning, we additionally run revisit tasks in Doom ( table 2 ) and showcase qualitative generalization on real-world video captures from Replay ( Shapovalov et al., 2023 ) . In Minecraft, evaluation spans two benchmark suites: 1. Solaris Benchmark ( Savva et al., 2026 ) : Evaluates five multi-agent capabilities using VLM-judged scripted questions, requiring all questions within an episode to be answered correctly. 2. MAC-Bench (Multi-Agent Consistency Benchmark) : Designed specifically to evaluate world and agent consistency in a harder setting. Specifically. we design the following three tasks: • Reunite at Start : Both agents return to their exact initial poses. Consequently, an agent’s partner must reappear at a previously observed spatial location. • Reunite Far : Agents navigate long, converging routes without visual contact in transit, turning to face each other upon arrival. A partner must appear at close range within previously unobserved space. • Dynamic Event : Agents observe the initial stage of a localized dynamic process ( e.g. , a chair catching fire) before separating. Upon return, the object state must reflect correct off-screen temporal evolution. In Doom, we design two Reunite tasks across six distinct maps with extended navigation paths.

blocks.zh: 4.1 多代理世界模型基准分析

blocks.en: As shown in table 1 , OverSeer leads on grounding, memory, and consistency, the Solaris capabilities that require spatial reasoning beyond the current view. Conversely, it trails the best baseline on building and movement tasks, which depend primarily on short-horizon egocentric streams. On MAC-Bench, OverSeer yields substantial gains in VLM accuracy over prior baselines, increasing scores from 0.0 % / 6.2 % / 12.5 % 0.0\%/6.2\%/12.5\% to 60.2 % / 37.9 % / 40.5 % 60.2\%/37.9\%/40.5\% across our three designed tasks (also qualitatively shown in fig. 5 ), while achieving the lowest (best) FID score across all tasks. Agent consistency is further demonstrated qualitatively in fig. 3 : projected 3D agent trajectories precisely align with generated agents across every auxiliary view in Minecraft, Doom, and real-world captures. Extended visualization rollouts are provided in appendix G .

blocks.en:
On Reunite at Start , Solaris obtains an FID of 17.06 17.06 , within 3.1 3.1 points of OverSeer, yet answers none of the episodes correctly.
While its generated rollouts remain visually in-distribution , they fail to reconstruct the specific scene previously left behind by the agents, frequently filling in existing craters or omitting partner agents entirely ( fig. 5 ).
This disconnect demonstrates that standard frame-level distributional metrics like FID are insensitive to structural memory failures, motivating the content-level queries proposed in our new benchmark.

索拉里斯在"开始"(Reunite at Start)获得17.06 17.06的FID,在"OverSeerr"(OverSeerr)的3.1 3.1分范围内,然而没有一次正确回答.
虽然其产生的喷发物仍然是可视的分布物,但它们未能重建以前被物剂留下的具体场景,经常填充现有弹坑或完全忽略伙伴物剂(图5)。
这种脱节表明,像FID这样的标准帧级分布度量衡对结构内存故障不敏感,激发了我们新基准中所建议的内容级查询.

blocks.en:
Both baselines enforce cross-agent agreement by coupling the agent streams directly, through concatenation or shared attention.
Under this design, every reference frame is itself a dynamic, partial observation, restricting agreement exclusively to moments when the agents’ fields of view overlap.
Empirical results directly reflect this structural limitation: once agents lose visual contact, γ \gamma -World does not achieve any of the reunite tasks.
The same argument accounts for the gap between Reunite at Start ( 60.2 60.2 ) and Reunite Far ( 37.9 37.9 ), as sampled cameras cover the start region more densely than the periphery.

经验结果直接反映了这种结构限制:一旦代理商失去视觉接触,\gamma - World就无法实现任何重合任务.

In cross-scene transfer experiments (decoding residual codes with a different “control” anchor latent), higher compression lowers PSNR but systematically suppresses donor background leakage.
Crucially, spatial placement precision and identity preservation of the transferred mover (Import IoU and Mover Id.) improve up to 8 × 8\times compression—peaking at 26.7 26.7 and 0.66 0.66 , respectively, before degrading at 16 × 16\times ( fig. 7 ).
Compression is thus more than an efficiency knob: an informational bottleneck too narrow to encode static background forces the model to allocate capacity to dynamic elements, causing dynamic-static disentanglement to naturally emerge from the constraint itself. We therefore adopt 8 × 8\times compression by default ( fig. 7 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced OverSeer, a multi-agent video world model that jointly generates egocentric
agent views and fixed-pose auxiliary views as a lightweight proxy for a world-centric state.
These views substantially improve consistency when agents separate and later reunite, and δ \delta -VAE makes them cheap to model by encoding only changes relative to a static
reference. We hope this simple yet effective design will pave the way for world models that simulate
shared environments beyond what any single agent sees.

这些观点在代理分离和后来的重合时大大提高了一致性,并且\\ delta - VAE 通过只编码相对于静态的改变,使其在模型上变得便宜.

blocks.en:
By applying 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial ( s = 2 s=2 ) and 2 × 2\times temporal ( τ = 2 \tau=2 ) compression rates, the δ \delta -VAE reduces the auxiliary view representation from 864 864 tokens per frame (at 576 × 384 576\times 384 resolution) to just 108 108 tokens, achieving an 8 × 8\times overall bandwidth reduction.
OverSeer jointly generates both agents’ egocentric streams and K K auxiliary views ( K = 6 K{=}6 by default for Minecraft and K = 8 K{=}8 for Doom) over a 241-frame horizon, conditioned on the initial frame of agent views and both agents’ action sequences.
Built upon Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , the model is fully fine-tuned per domain for 20k steps using Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 64 across 64 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.
Training incorporates diffusion forcing and causal masking over a context window of 12 latent frames (48 RGB frames), with autoregressive rollout used during inference.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: OverSeer’s benefits depend on auxiliary coverage. Regions far from the sampled cameras, as in Reunite Far , remain harder to keep consistent. Short-horizon egocentric capabilities such as movement do not benefit from auxiliary views. Aggressive residual compression also trades some fidelity and, in fast-changing scenes such as Doom, consistency for efficiency. Promising directions include adaptive or learned camera placement that follows agents into unexplored regions, auxiliary views that are re-anchored for unbounded worlds, and scaling to larger agent populations. More broadly, we hope this work encourages treating the output space of world models, meaning what they choose to render and not only what they condition on, as a first-class design axis for building coherent, shared simulated worlds.
blocks.zh: Oversear的津贴取决于辅助保险。 远离采样摄像头的区域,如在Reunite Far,仍然难以保持一致。 短视的自我中心能力,如运动,没有从辅助观点中受益. 冲动的剩余压缩也交换了某种忠诚感,在迅速变化的场景中,如Doom,一致性是为了效率. 有希望的方向包括:适应性或学习的相机放置,跟踪物剂进入未探索的区域,为无界世界重新选择的辅助视图,以及扩大成更大的物剂种群。 更广泛地说,我们希望这项工作鼓励将世界模型的输出空间,即它们所选择的输出空间,而不仅仅是它们所附带的条件,作为建设连贯、共享的模拟世界的一流设计轴心。

blocks.en:
Actions reach the model as language. Each of the 28 entries of the action vocabulary is written
as one English sentence, encoded once by the text encoder, and stored as a table of token
sequences; at training and at inference the sentence of the frame’s action is looked up and its
tokens are used as the frame’s conditioning context. Table 5 lists the
sentences.

作为英文句子,由文本编码器编码一次,并存储为符号表
在培训和推论中,对框架行动的句子进行了审视,

句号。

blocks.en:
Per frame exactly one entry is chosen. The keyboard flags score one when pressed; the mouse
contributes through its yaw and pitch, whose sign picks turning left or right and looking up or
down and whose magnitude is clipped to one; if nothing scores above zero, the frame is idle. The
highest score wins, so a frame that both walks and turns is conditioned on the stronger of the
two. The conditioning frame’s tokens are zeroed, since it is given rather than generated, and
during training the whole action context is dropped with a fixed probability so that the model
can be sampled with classifier-free guidance on the actions.
